name: Saiinjutsushi ~Chijoku Mamire no Zecchou~
original_name: 催淫術師～恥辱まみれの絶頂～
source:
The main character lives a boring life, just going to school and coming back home. But one day, a strange girl appears and tells him, "I'll blow your boredom away." She gives him a pendant and a book about hypnotism. These items awake his secret ability, hypnotism.... Using this ability, he randomly has sex with his classmates, aunts, and cousins....

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/8887]HimeyaShop[/url]]
translation: 主人公过着无聊的生活，每天不过是上学、回家两点一线。然而某天，一个神秘的女孩出现了，对他说："我会帮你赶走无聊。"她给了他一条吊坠和一本关于催眠术的书。这些东西唤醒了他隐藏的能力——催眠术……凭借这种能力，他与同学、阿姨、表姐妹等各色女性发生了关系……\n\n[来自[url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/8887]HimeyaShop[/url]]
